interface.shortDescription: Run native Codex orchestration and independent Claude review through AirWorker.
interface.longDescription: AirWorker is the sole native executor, judge and learning runtime for Codex, Claude and Hermes adapters. Use native session, PLAN, orchestrate and semantic receipts; the separate signed llm-queue worker is an optional heavy-task capability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the installed AirWorker kernel and woody skill, never direct Codex/Claude provider tools. After native session declare and PLAN readback, run the approved coding route with exactly TWO native Codex patch-author subagents: air-worker orchestrate -product <root> -subagents 2, or the canonical Hermes air_worker(action=run). The native kernel selects Codex from script, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra; escalate on proved cause only, never march all tiers blindly. Each Codex subagent reads the original TASK, authors a concrete unified source patch under its own read-only process receipt, and does not alter the shared source; the Codex leader integrates patches as the single shared-tree workspace-write owner. Narrative-only reviews do NOT count as coding subagents. Require real source changes, factual Go RC, immutable receipts and an independent native Anthropic Sonnet/Opus judge before acceptance. Standalone executor dispatch is forbidden for this managed two-subagent product, and the previous two sequential dispatch pilots are historical only. Keep G07/G06/G05/G08 and release/install gates distinct. Never use Codex App Server, direct claude -p, PAYG or a custom router.
